europe_now.title: Poland Detains Man Suspected of Plotting Against Prime Minister Tusk
europe_now.summary: Polish security services and police have detained a suspect in connection with an alleged assassination plot targeting Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Officials noted that recent stabbings in the country have been exacerbated by online glorification of violence.

europe_now.title: Trump and Zelenskyy Clash Over Energy Ceasefire and Leadership
europe_now.summary: Donald Trump announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, though President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated the announcement was news to him. Meanwhile, European leaders expressed backing for Zelenskyy after Trump called for a new Ukrainian leader.
